SDBC Sunday Funday Ride

San Diego, CA · Road

SDBC Sunday Funday Ride is a road group ride in San Diego, CA. It rolls every Sunday at 8:30 am from Varies weekly (the first rides met at UC Cyclery). Pace: d1/D2 pace, about 14 to 17 mph, 33 to 55 miles with regroups.

For visitors

Helmets required. No e-bikes, earbuds, aero bars or flashing lights. You must be able to find your way back to the start if you get dropped. The club's weekly update lists the week's start.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 14 to 17 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at @sandiegobicycleclub the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the SDBC Sunday Funday Ride group ride

A Sunday ride led by an SDBC ride leader, built around variety and coffee-stop camaraderie. Routes run 33 to 55 miles and change each week, as does the start. The club's Saturday ride is already on the site.
